title: Introduce invocation-context denormalizer and attenuated latency signal pipeline
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds a denormalized invocation context stream, a lightweight attenuation layer for noisy latency signals, and a dashboard for fast-path detection. Backwards compatible consumer APIs. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: We continue to see noisy tail latency alerts driven by high-cardinality context joins and duplicated context keys emitted from the serving runtime. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: 1) an invocation-context denormalizer that produces a compact, canonical invocation record (reduces cardinality and deduplicates context blobs), and 2) a latency-signal attenuator that downweights highly noisy token-phase signals before they feed into alert windows and SLO rollups. Goals are to reduce alert fatigue, improve SLO signal-to-noise, and make downstream aggregation cheaper.

What this changes (high level):
- New ingestion pipeline stage (denormalizer) that consumes span/context messages and emits canonical invocation objects with stable keys and sampled context anchors. Configurable retention of full context blobs for 1% of invocations for debugging.
- Attenuator service applied as a deterministic pre-aggregation transform: computes a noise score per token-phase stream and applies weight clipping + hysteresis to reduce transient spikes affecting percentile-based SLOs.
- New dashboard: Obs/Invocations/Denorm & Attenuated-Latency summarizing pre/post attenuation p50/p95/p99, noise score histogram, and cost impact estimate.
- Small SDK/ingest changes: telemetry protobuf version bump, compatibility shim in event-forwarder.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc (ENG-5182) reviewed by SRE and telemetry.
- [x] Integration tests for denormalizer canonicalization.
- [x] E2E latency pipeline test with synthetic noisy traces.
- [x] Dashboard panels and runbook entry added.
- [x] Feature gated and rollout plan prepared (start at 1% tenants, ramp to 20% after 72h).

Risk and mitigation: Denormalizer changes keys used by some downstream consumers. To avoid breakage we emit both legacy and canonical keys for 7 days and provide a consumer migration lint. The attenuator is opt-in per-tenant via config; default rollout starts in observability staging.

Operational notes: The attenuator computes a "noise_score" (0-1) using inter-arrival variance and token-phase entropy; values >0.7 are clipped progressively. Config knobs: noise_window_ms, clip_threshold, hysteresis_ms. Rolling metrics available under telemetry.invocation.denorm.* and telemetry.invocation.attenuator.*.

Related: ENG-5223 (dashboard and SLO tuning), incident INC-2026-02 (noisy token-phase SLOs).
commits: 3 commits: (1) core: add denormalizer pipeline and proto definitions; (2) service: implement attenuator with configurable policy and unit tests; (3) ops: dashboard panels + rollout script + runbook references.
review_comments: Diego Hernandez: Nice approach. A few concerns: 1) can we make the canonical key derivation deterministic across language SDKs? Please add test vectors. 2) The default clip_threshold feels aggressive at 0.5; recommend 0.75 for initial rollout.

Maya Patel (author): Added test vectors in denorm.proto and a cross-SDK reference implementation in sdk/telemetry/compat_shim.go. Bumped default clip_threshold to 0.75 and made it tenant-configurable. Updated tests.
Katherine Li: Observability nit: add a per-tenant delta panel showing 'pre vs post attenuation' for p95 to validate effect. Also please include annotation points in dashboard for rollout windows.
Maya Patel (author): Added p95 delta panel and rollout annotations. Added runbook steps to dashboards/README.md.
Samir Rao: On the migration path — consumers that expect legacy context keys should get a deprecation lint. Can we emit a migration metric so we can track remaining consumers?
Maya Patel (author): Emitting telemetry.invocation.denorm.migration.remaining_count and added a consumer-lint job to integration-tests.
ci_checks: CI passed: build (ok), unit-tests (ok), integration-tests (ok, flakiness 0.8%), lint (ok), security-scan (ok). One flaky integration test re-run during CI; second run passed.
post_merge_actions: Deployed to observability-staging behind feature-gate for tenant subset 1..20. Run rollout script scripts/release/rollout_denorm.sh. Monitoring: watch telemetry.invocation.attenuator.noise_score and pre/post p95 delta for the first 24h; rollback on >10% increase in error budget burn for any tenant.
notes_for_changelog: Introduce invocation denormalizer and latency attenuator pipeline: improves SLO stability by reducing noisy token-phase spikes and lowers aggregation cost via canonicalized invocation records. Feature-gated; no customer API changes.
